theme_strategy.rationale: MailMind AI is a professional AI Email Intelligence & Data Science platform designed for MSc evaluators, technical leaders, and data scientists. Deep obsidian/navy (#090D16, #0D1322) paired with crisp electric cyan (#06B6D4) and soft violet (#8B5CF6) conveys high-grade algorithmic precision, security telemetry, and modern data-lab authority without visual fatigue.

entry_surfaces./: minimal product brand entry — MailMind AI title, telemetry badge + single prominent Start button
entry_surfaces./dashboard: desktop command grid — key ML KPIs top, pipeline health + real-time intelligence feeds below
entry_surfaces./inbox: desktop split inbox — dense filterable table on left (45%), deep NLP/security inspection on right (55%)
entry_surfaces./analyze: interactive ML pipeline lab — dual view with raw email parser, NER extraction, intent classifier, and explainability cards
entry_surfaces./analytics: data science telemetry studio — time-range selector, model confusion matrix, ROC-AUC comparison, SHAP feature importance

layout_and_grids.structure: Desktop-first persistent shell (250px collapsible sidebar, 60px command top bar with Quick Search & status badge, flex-1 scrollable work area)
layout_and_grids.split_inspector_col: col-span-12 lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto pr-1
layout_and_grids.spacing_rules: Generous card padding (p-5 to p-6), 1px crisp borders (#1E293B), nested radius (parent rounded-xl: 12px, child rounded-lg: 8px)

motion_and_interactions.hover_transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out
motion_and_interactions.visual_effects: Subtle 1px border shimmer on high-threat alert badges, linear telemetry scanning lines on active ML analysis

categories: Named Entity Recognition (Entities: Org, Person, Money, URL, Sensitive Token)
Action Item / Intent Extraction (Regex + Zero-shot classification)
Explainability (SHAP / LIME attribution bars & high-risk token highlights)
data_science_and_nlp_features.simulated_data_badge_policy: Clearly display 'Simulated ML Demo' / 'Real-time FastText Model' status pills so evaluators and professors recognize genuine architectural integrity.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum) ensured on all dark surfaces with explicit slate-100/50 text
accessibility_and_testing.test_id_policy: All interactive buttons, filter tabs, search bars, table rows, and submit triggers MUST include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="start-app-button", data-testid="inbox-filter-phishing", data-testid="analyze-submit-button").
accessibility_and_testing.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (sidebar toggle, refresh, theme switch) carry explicit aria-label.

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild MailMind AI as an authoritative desktop-first AI Intelligence & Data Science SaaS.

First route ('/'): Render a clean, ultra-premium minimal landing screen with ONLY the website name 'MailMind AI', high-tech subtitle, system status indicator, and a prominent 'Start Platform' button (NO login/auth page as strictly requested by user).
Clicking 'Start' immediately routes to the main platform ('/dashboard').

Implement the persistent 250px collapsible sidebar, top bar with Quick Search (Cmd+K modal), simulated data notifications, and clean sub-routes: /dashboard, /inbox, /analyze, /analytics, /models, /settings.

Inbox must feature desktop split-view: selectable email list on left with category/threat chips, and comprehensive deep intelligence inspector on the right (Security, NLP Entities, Summarization, Sentiment, Explainability, Quick Actions).
Analyze page allows pasting raw email headers + body with real-time pipeline visualization (Tokenizer -> Feature Extraction -> BERT/RandomForest -> Explainability).

Analytics page showcases MSc-level ML metrics: Confusion Matrix, ROC-AUC Curves (BERT vs Random Forest vs Naive Bayes), SHAP Token Importance, and Time-range volume trends using preinstalled Recharts.
Use mock/simulated realistic datasets populated in MongoDB / FastAPI with fallback state if the backend is quiet.
Keep styling sharp, dense, professional, using dark obsidian slate palettes (#090D16, #0F172A), neon cyan (#06B6D4) and soft violet (#8B5CF6) highlights.
